description: [No sign-in required] Read the requirements and evidence for each criterion in one chosen template revision. To browse by scenario, use findTemplates first. Copy slug and version from the same catalog item, for example {"slug":"business-automation","version":1}. Compare the returned digest with your saved selection. An unavailable revision returns 404. On 404 or a digest change, review a fresh selection.
